usedFor: Nifty holds project tasks, and viaSocket utilities adds a wait with “Pause Workflow” after “New Task Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created” in Nifty, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A pause after a new task gives later steps time before they run.

watchOut: “Pause Workflow” waits for a set number of minutes, so every later step starts late by design.
